author: GitHub
description:
The GitHub mobile app just got a highly requested upgrade. You can now create new repositories directly from your phone on both iOS and Android. Set your repo to public or private, pick an account, and even select a template right from the app. It is the perfect way to kick off your next side project the moment inspiration strikes. Open the app and start building from anywhere.

#GitHub #GitHubMobile #GitHubApp
